result:
The billing component now shows a "Manage billing" link to https://homelab.local/billing/portal. Both changes are merged, CI and CD passed on each, and I marked the ticket done. I only built locally and checked that the link is in the built `dist/main.js`; I didn't open the deployed page.

- **PR #1 (contracts):** adds `billingPortalUrl` to the shared config in `@mfe/shared-contracts`. I bumped the version to 1.1.0 because the change is additive, and CD published it to the registry.
- **PR #2 (billing):** updates the billing dependency to `^1.1.0` (with the lockfile) and renders the link from `SHARED_CONFIG.billingPortalUrl`, so the address isn't hardcoded in the billing app.

I used two PRs because the contract has to be published before billing can depend on it. I put the new field next to the existing `billingUrl` rather than changing that one.

Nothing slowed me down. `st task add` takes the task text directly, but I only found out how `st pr open` works from `st help`.
